verdict.rationale: The only residency evidence is a marketing-page line listing "EU and India data residency" (docs-5/25). Zero-retention mode via enable_logging=false (docs-20) is an adjacent retention control, not region choice, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documentation of how users select a region (endpoint, account setting or API parameter), which regions are available beyond EU/India, which data the residency covers, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
